name: Review open vendor bills for due, overdue and duplicate bills
description: Every Monday an AI agent reads open vendor bills from QuickBooks Online through its query API. It lists bills due in the next seven days and overdue bills, flags likely duplicates with the matching bill side by side, keeps recurring bills apart, and flags bills missing a due date, memo or PO. Totals are given per currency, and the summary is posted to your finance Slack channel before the payment run.
shortDescription: A weekly pre-payment-run check of vendor bills: due, overdue, duplicates and missing details.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the vendor-bill-review skill and an HTTP Client tool for the QuickBooks Online query API
Duplicate detection that always shows the matching bill ID
Recurring bills (rent, subscriptions) listed apart from duplicates
Read-only: no bill is created, approved, paid, edited or voided
prerequisites: The `vendor-bill-review` skill created under Settings → AI → Skills, from the SKILL.md in the blue canvas note
HTTP Client OAuth2 connection to QuickBooks Online (Intuit app client ID and secret, scope com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting) and your company (realm) ID in the system prompt
Slack connection and the ID of the finance channel
idealFor: Finance and accounts payable teams that want a clean list before every payment run.
steps: Review the bills: the AI Agent loads the vendor-bill-review skill, queries open bills from QuickBooks Online and builds the four sections.
Post the summary to the finance Slack channel.
